title: juicy british egg wrap
description: a sweet and shattering lacto-vegetarian-friendly breakfast dish featuring egg roll wrappers and a grill.

ingredients.name: egg roll wrappers (4-6 wrappers)
ingredients.notes: found in most supermarkets or international grocery stores

ingredients.name: grilled mushrooms
ingredients.notes: button, cremini, or shiitake work well

ingredients.name: gruyère cheese
ingredients.notes: or substitute with other Swiss-style cheese

ingredients.name: cooking oil or butter
ingredients.notes: for brushing grill and egg wrappers

instructions: preheat the grill to medium heat.
brush the grill with oil or butter to prevent sticking.
scramble the eggs in a bowl and set aside.
brush the egg roll wrappers with oil or butter and grill for 30 seconds on each side, until lightly browned.
grill the mushrooms and asparagus until tender and lightly browned.
cook the bacon in a pan until crispy, then chop into small pieces.
warm the scrambled eggs on the grill or in the microwave.
assemble the wraps by spooning the eggs, mushrooms, asparagus, bacon, and cheese onto the egg roll wrappers.
drizzle with honey and sprinkle with chives.
